items.title: An Appraisal of Constructivist Psychotherapies
items.rights_note: ERIC abstract and bibliographic record identifies four clinical lineages; article body is not open here, so this is not a full-text read.

items.title: Constructivism in Psychotherapy
items.rights_note: Open Library bibliographic page for the 1995 APA volume; borrow/preview status does not authorize caching the book body.

items.title: Personal Construct Therapy vs Cognitive Behavioral Therapy in the Treatment of Depression in Women with Fibromyalgia
items.rights_note: Open protocol defining personal construct therapy, repertory-grid and implicative-dilemma methods; one constructivist lineage, not the whole family.

items.title: Cognitive-Behavioral and Personal Construct Therapies for Depression in Women with Fibromyalgia: A Randomized Controlled Trial
items.rights_note: Open condition-specific RCT comparing modular PCT with CBT; no significant between-treatment difference and deterioration counts must remain explicit.

items.title: Psychotherapy focusing on dialogical and narrative perspectives: a systematic review from qualitative and mixed-methods studies
items.rights_note: Open review of dialogical and narrative approaches that reference constructivist thinking; adjacent descendants must not stand for all constructivist psychotherapy.

items.title: European Association for Constructivism and Meaning-Centered Practices
items.rights_note: Current association self-description and institutional-member list; evidence of continuation only, not independent theory or efficacy support.
